name: Status card
description: Service status panel: a coloured overall status, the incident title, a timeline of updates (newest first) and optional per-component states.

params.name: service
params.help: Service or product name above the status (empty: none)

params.name: status
params.help: Overall status: green operational, amber degraded, orange partial-outage, red major-outage, blue maintenance

params.name: headline
params.help: Status line text (empty: from the status, e.g. All systems operational)

params.name: updates
params.help: Up to 6 rows, newest first: time (e.g. 14:32), text

params.name: components
params.help: Up to 8 rows: component name, status (operational, degraded, partial-outage, major-outage or maintenance; other text is shown grey)

example.incident: Elevated error rates on EU checkout
updates: Cause identified: a faulty cache node.
